purpose: Choose one working research candidate, not a clinically accepted production policy.
urgent_improvement_requirements: ESI 2 predicted as 3-5 is lower than baseline
ESI 2 predicted as 4-5 is no greater than baseline
Overall under-triage is no greater than baseline
primary_selection: Among candidates meeting these requirements and at least baseline accuracy, choose lowest ESI 2 under-triage, then highest accuracy, then lowest over-triage.
fallback_selection: If none also preserves accuracy, show the trade-off and select the highest-accuracy candidate meeting the urgent-improvement requirements, then lowest ESI 2 under-triage. If none meets those requirements, retain baseline.
reporting: Also report the accuracy leader and urgent-recall leader, all 22 results, per-hospital results, and over-triage. No clinical maximum over-triage or harm ratio is inferred. Selected results are development estimates after model comparison, not untouched final-test performance.
